summary: REQUEST_CHANGES on diagnostics generation-14 PR #438 exact head 3d9a1e4bfc322b4dd634718719eeb4b23552ff9c. The production Archivable clone-completeness fence is coherent, but the generation exists specifically to eliminate false-pass source-contract tests and its strengthened hasCompleteCloneProof matcher still searches raw helper text. The exact DESCENDANT_BLOCK can be retained inside a helper-local long comment or long string after removing the executable descendant loop, so the matcher can still certify inert text. Add an inert-comment/string mutant and harden or replace the matcher, then rerun exact-head CI and obtain a fresh independent review. No Studio/viewport evidence is requested or claimed.
evidence: Reviewed PR #438 exact head 3d9a1e4bfc322b4dd634718719eeb4b23552ff9c; PR-specific canonical CI run 31590116510 is PASS and Swarm engine-tests are PASS on that same head.

Production captureCanonicalWhileDiagnosticsEnabled performs the model Archivable guard, exhaustive GetDescendants scan, exact owned-overlay exemption, non-overlay Archivable assertion, then Clone() before strict Validation.captureFull(clone); no production correctness defect was found in that fence.

It does not lex/strip long comments or strings or otherwise prove the matched text is executable.

A helper can keep the model-level assert and Clone() live while placing the exact DESCENDANT_BLOCK bytes inside --[[ ... ]] or [[ ... ]] after deleting the executable scan; raw string.find still locates the inert block and preserves the expected textual ordering.

Current negative mutants cover model-only, broadened overlay exemption, explicit loop break, and conventionally indented if-false wrapper, but not an inert raw-text copy. This is the same false-pass class generation 14 is intended to close, so integration should remain blocked until covered.
